final: SELECT s1.staff_id, s1.total, s1.total / s2.grand FROM (SELECT p.staff_id AS staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY p.staff_id) s1 JOIN (SELECT SUM(total) AS grand FROM (SELECT p.staff_id AS staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY p.staff_id)) s2 ON s2.grand IS NOT NULL
